# Shopify

> Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform enabling businesses to build, sell, and grow across online stores, retail, and multiple sales channels.

Shopify provides a comprehensive suite of tools for ecommerce, point-of-sale systems, multi-channel selling, and business automation. The platform serves businesses of all sizes, from startups to enterprises, with AI-powered features like Sidekick and Shopify Magic integrated throughout.

## Key Topics

- Shopify POS
- Sidekick AI
- Shopify Magic
- Shopify Payments
- Shopify Plus
- Omnichannel selling
- B2B commerce
- Email marketing
- Store customization
- Global expansion
- Marketing automation
- Checkout optimization
- Shopify App Store
- Multi-channel integration
- Customer acquisition

## Getting Started

- [Shopify: The All-in-One Commerce Platform](https://www.shopify.com): Shopify all-in-one commerce platform for managing every aspect of your business
- [Start Your Online Store Today](https://www.shopify.com/start): Quick-start onboarding guide to launch your Shopify store for free
- [Ecommerce Website Builder](https://www.shopify.com/website/builder): AI-powered website builder with themes for creating free online stores
- [Ecommerce Website Templates](https://themes.shopify.com): 800+ free and premium Shopify themes for store customization and design

## Core Commerce Solutions

- [Build Your Online Store](https://www.shopify.com/online): Online store building options with themes or headless commerce solutions
- [Point of Sale (POS) for Business](https://www.shopify.com/pos): Shopify POS system for retail inventory, checkout, and omnichannel selling
- [Sales Channels on Shopify](https://www.shopify.com/channels): Multi-channel selling integration with Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and social
- [Sell on Shop Marketplace](https://www.shopify.com/shop): Shop marketplace platform to reach millions of shoppers with no fees

## AI & Automation

- [Sidekick: AI Commerce Assistant](https://www.shopify.com/sidekick): Sidekick AI commerce assistant for store building and business automation
- [Shopify Magic and Sidekick](https://www.shopify.com/magic): Shopify Magic AI tools for content creation, email, and commerce automation

## Marketing & Customer Engagement

- [Marketing on Shopify](https://www.shopify.com/marketing): Integrated marketing tools for customer acquisition, automation, and analytics
- [Marketing Automation Tools](https://www.shopify.com/marketing-automation-tools): Email, messaging, and forms for marketing automation and customer engagement
- [Launch Powerful Discount Promotions](https://www.shopify.com/discounts): Discount and promotion tools for boosting sales and customer retention
- [Customer Accounts](https://www.shopify.com/customer-accounts): Customer portal for self-service order and subscription management

## Enterprise & Advanced Solutions

- [Shopify for Enterprise](https://www.shopify.com/enterprise): Enterprise solutions for unified commerce with POS and B2B capabilities
- [B2B Commerce Platform](https://www.shopify.com/plus/solutions/b2b-ecommerce): Shopify Plus B2B platform for wholesale and direct-to-consumer integration

## Global Expansion

- [Sell to International Customers](https://www.shopify.com/international): Global expansion tools with localization and cross-border commerce support
- [Expand Into New Markets](https://www.shopify.com/markets): Multi-market expansion with localization for B2B, D2C, and retail POS

## Optional

- [Sell More and Spend Less](https://www.shopify.com/sell): Migration and platform comparison highlighting Shopify's sales growth benefits
- [Buy a Domain Name](https://www.shopify.com/domains): Domain registration and management with SSL security for Shopify stores
